arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native pixel-art combat animation SOURCE ATLAS of Adam Jensen, EXACT selected incarnation: Deus Ex: Human Revolution (2011).

APPEARANCE AND EQUIPMENT: Adult Adam Jensen, black-and-gold coat, short dark hair and beard, retractable dark glasses, black mechanical forearms; no later appearance. Specified action equipment: Typhoon augmentation. Selected action: Décharge locale du Typhoon de Jensen.

Adult character, nonsexual practical game presentation. Recognizable clean detailed 16-bit sprites. All figures face screen-right in a coherent three-quarter side view. Same character design, body proportions and anatomical scale in all cells; crouching is naturally shorter. All full bodies and all equipment completely inside their cells, with generous empty transparent margins.

STRICT LAYOUT: exactly FORTY-EIGHT separate complete figures, EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS (8 x 6 regular grid). TRANSPARENT background. No labels, numbers, text, grid lines, panels, floor, cast shadow, scenery or other people. Every successive group of four pictures is a genuine FOUR-FRAME sequence with four independently drawn DIFFERENT poses; never duplicate complete figures. Leave clear horizontal and vertical gutters between every full figure, including weapon tips.

ROW 1, columns 1-4 INTRO: calmly enter readiness with specified equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 OUTRO: lower equipment/hands, slight turn, step or shift to leave, settle. No attacking in either sequence.

ROW 2, columns 1-4 ROUND VICTORY: a restrained individual acknowledgment with specified equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: catch breath or settle balance, stoop slightly, steady, recover. No attacking.

ROW 3, columns 1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Brace mechanical arms and coat into compact radial system activation and recover; finite local effect, no beam, no victim; columns 5-8 MATCH VICTORY: a distinctive calm personal recognition gesture and settle, visibly different from round victory. No attacking in victory.

ROW 4, columns 1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: slowly crouch or lower posture, bow head or settle shoulders, regain balance, settle; no injury; columns 5-8 SUPER: a separate newly drawn sequence of Brace mechanical arms and coat into compact radial system activation and recover; finite local effect, no beam, no victim, different drawings from the finishing presentation.

ROW 5, columns 1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing or weight-transfer poses with specified equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 RUN: four complete different locomotion-cycle poses, specified equipment retained safely, preserving source body stature.

ROW 6, columns 1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Brace mechanical arms and coat into compact radial system activation and recover; finite local effect, no beam, no victim, separate new drawings from super; columns 5-8 HIT REACTION: non-graphic recoil, protective posture, recover balance, settle.

Solo non-graphic animation acting only. No victim, opponent, blood, wounds, severing, corpse or death spectacle. Quiet intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit rows never attack, fire, emit offensive effects or invent abilities. Preserve source anatomy, costume, exact equipment and exact 48-figure 8-by-6 layout. No generalized aura, body glow, unrelated tool or borrowed power.

Typhoon action is a compact finite RADIAL local activation of torso augmentation. No gun, directed beam, laser or continuous ray.
